question: Which constructors had the top 3 combined points from their best driver and team, and in which years did they achieve them?
sql:
WITH constructor_yearly AS (
    SELECT 
        r.year,
        cs.constructor_id,
        SUM(cs.points) as constructor_total_points
    FROM races r
    JOIN constructor_standings cs ON r.race_id = cs.race_id
    GROUP BY r.year, cs.constructor_id
),
driver_yearly AS (
    SELECT 
        r.year,
        d.constructor_id,
        ds.driver_id,
        SUM(ds.points) as driver_total_points
    FROM races r
    JOIN driver_standings ds ON r.race_id = ds.race_id
    JOIN drives d ON r.year = d.year AND ds.driver_id = d.driver_id
    GROUP BY r.year, d.constructor_id, ds.driver_id
),
best_drivers AS (
    SELECT 
        year,
        constructor_id,
        MAX(driver_total_points) as best_driver_points
    FROM driver_yearly
    GROUP BY year, constructor_id
),
combined_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        cy.year,
        cy.constructor_id,
        cy.constructor_total_points,
        bd.best_driver_points,
        cy.constructor_total_points + bd.best_driver_points as combined_points
    FROM constructor_yearly cy
    JOIN best_drivers bd ON cy.year = bd.year AND cy.constructor_id = bd.constructor_id
),
top3_per_year AS (
    SELECT 
        year,
        constructor_id,
        combined_points,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY combined_points DESC) as rank
    FROM combined_scores
    QUALIFY rank <= 3
)
SELECT 
    t.year,
    c.name as constructor_name,
    t.combined_points
FROM top3_per_year t
JOIN constructors c ON t.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
ORDER BY t.year, t.combined_points DESC
